name: Ashiya (Hyōgo, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ashiya city emblem in yellow: a ring crossed by horizontal bars, like a rising sun.
history: Municipal flag of Ashiya, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 3 November 1964; the emblem dates from 31 March 1922.

features.role: Ashiya city emblem — a ring crossed by horizontal bars, like a rising sun
